transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. 

Well, I came in because I just feel wound up almost all day long. It's... it's like my body is constantly bracing for something. Even when there's nothing going on, like when I'm just sitting at my computer for work, or trying to relax after dinner, I just have this constant tension that I can't seem to shake.
Do you experience sudden, intense surges of fear or discomfort that peak within a few minutes?

No, I haven't really had anything like that. It's not... it doesn't hit me all of a sudden or peak like you're describing. It's really just that steady, constant background tension I mentioned. It just kind of stays there all day.
Has there been a specific, stressful life event or significant change in your life that occurred within the last three months?

No, not really. I mean, my life is pretty routine right now. Work is just the usual day-to-day stuff, and there hasn't been any major upheaval or big changes lately. Everything is pretty much the same as it's been for a while.
For how many months have you been feeling this constant tension?
Let's see... it's been going on for about thirteen months now. It really started right around the time my sister down in Arecibo began needing a lot more help from our family.
Do you find that you have a hard time controlling your worries about various aspects of your life, such as your work, your health, or your family?

Yes, it's very hard to control. I'll be at work, and I'll tell myself, "Daniela, enough, focus on this report." But it doesn't work. One small thought just turns into five more, and before I know it, I've spent half an hour checking messages or just replaying all the things that could go wrong. I just can't seem to turn it off.
Do you often feel restless, or as if you are keyed up or on edge?

Yes, I do. Honestly, that's a big part of why I came in. I just feel wound up almost all day long. It's like my body is constantly... bracing for something. Even when I’m just sitting at my computer working, or trying to relax after dinner, I still feel that way.
Aside from feeling restless or on edge, do you often experience muscle tension in your body?

Not really, no. I mean, my shoulders get a little stiff sometimes just from sitting at my computer for work all day, but... no, I haven't really noticed any actual muscle tension. It's mostly just that restless, wound-up feeling I mentioned.
Do you find that you have trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or that your sleep feels restless and unsatisfying?

Yes, I do have some trouble there. Most nights I do fall asleep eventually, but... I tend to wake up around three or four in the morning. And right away, my mind starts going, thinking about my sister’s next appointment or worrying about some server issue at work. It's frustrating, because even when I do manage to get enough hours, I start the morning feeling like I never really rested at all.
Do you often feel easily fatigued or worn out during the day?

Not really, no. You'd think I would, given what I just said about my sleep, but... I don't actually feel worn out during the day. I usually have plenty of energy to get through my work and everything else. It's really just that restless, keyed-up feeling I have, rather than fatigue.
Do you find that your mind often goes blank, or that it is difficult for you to concentrate on what you are doing?

No, I haven't really noticed that. My mind doesn't go blank, and I don't usually have trouble concentrating. If anything, my mind is going a little too fast, like I mentioned before with the worrying. But no, focusing on my work or other things hasn't been an issue for me.
